# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 105 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 105 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_105_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — The Foundation of the Tower

**1** "Lord, I have to ask again — why is the tower built on water?" "I already told you," he said, "but you're asking again. So you really want to understand this thoroughly." "Lord," I said, "I couldn't hold onto it — it's so profound and extraordinary that I have to hear it again." **2** "All right, listen," he said. "Here is why the tower stands on water: **3** Your life was saved through water — and will be saved through it. But the tower itself was founded on the word of the Almighty and glorious Name, and it is held in place by the Lord's invisible power." **4** "Lord," I said, "that is extraordinary. But if the Lord's Name is what is so glorious — how exactly is the tower founded on that Name?" **5** "Because the Name of the Lord is vast and limitless," he said, "and it holds up the entire creation. **6** If the whole created universe is sustained by the Name of the Lord, how much more is the tower — which rests on that Name — upheld and supported by it?" **7** "And the six glorious men standing around the tower with the young men?" **8** "These are the six holy angels of God — the very first to be created. The Lord placed the whole of his creation into their care to be governed and built up. Through these six the tower is governed and brought to completion. **9** The others who helped are angels of a second order." When I asked about them, he confirmed: "Yes — the first ones are the firstborn angels of God." **10** "Lord," I asked, "is the tower complete now?" "It will be complete," he said, "when the Lord sends his final word and the servants of God are judged worthy of life."

---

*PNEUMA renders the Name-as-foundation theology in clear terms, and "final commission" as "final word" — the divine word that triggers the eschatological judgment.*
